caption:
"Do a brain dump. Get it all out." You did. It's all still in your head. Because dumping without an ending isn't release — it's rehearsal. The Dump Close gives the dump an ending.

We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this for the next brain dump.
